chars.HUSBAND: a 38-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, wearing a charcoal grey blazer over a light blue shirt, dark trousers
chars.WIFE: a 33-year-old Moroccan woman wearing a burgundy hijab, a long camel trench coat and small gold earrings
chars.JUDGE: an older Moroccan judge with grey hair and glasses, wearing a black judicial robe with a white collar, seated at a raised wooden bench
chars.LOVER: a handsome 27-year-old Moroccan man with styled black hair, wearing an olive green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan family courtroom with wooden benches and a Moroccan flag on the wall. The WIFE stands in the centre, mid-speech, turning and pointing an accusing finger at the HUSBAND who stands a few steps away looking stunned. Both faces clearly visible, head-to-waist framing, subjects in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan courtroom the HUSBAND, calm and determined, hands a thick folder of photos and papers up to the JUDGE at the raised wooden bench. The judge looks at the photos with raised eyebrows.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan courtroom the WIFE presses a hand to her chest and wipes a fake tear with a tissue, speaking dramatically towards the judge's bench, eyes sly. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan courtroom the WIFE points at the HUSBAND while speaking loudly; the HUSBAND behind her opens his mouth in shock, palms up in disbelief.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of the HUSBAND in the courtroom, eyes wide, hand on his forehead in disbelief, people murmuring on the wooden benches behind him, slightly blurred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan courtroom the HUSBAND stands confidently holding a stack of medical papers, two serious witnesses (an older man in a brown djellaba and a woman in a navy hijab) standing beside him ready to testify.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the courtroom the WIFE stands with her chin up, shameless, while behind her on a bench her older parents (a grey-haired father in a white djellaba and a mother in a dark green djellaba and headscarf) cover their faces in shame.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE in the court hallway smirking greedily, holding up a legal document and counting on her fingers, scheming expression. Medium shot.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a modern Moroccan apartment living room: the WIFE sits on a sofa throwing her hands up in frustration while the LOVER stands in front of her shaking his head, arms crossed, tension between them.
